source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 2 exercise solved (PDF 48-50): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of the following component is not found in all kinds of bacteria?
(Kaun sa hissa har qisam ke bacteria mein nahi paya jata?)
blocks.explanation: Har bacterium mein ribosomes, cell membrane aur nucleoid hote hain, magar capsule sirf kuch bacteria cell wall ke bahar banate hain (2.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. The bacterial chromosome is typically:
(Bacteria ka chromosome aam tor par kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterium mein nucleoid ke andar ek gol (circular), double-stranded DNA hota hai jis ke saath histones nahi hote (2.1).

blocks.prompt:
3. In bacterial cells, respiration occurs at:
(Bacteria ke cells mein respiration kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria mein mitochondria nahi hote; cell membrane aur us ke andar mude hisse (mesosomes) respiration ke markaz hain (2.1).

blocks.prompt:
4. Which group of bacteria is known as a good source of antibiotics?
(Bacteria ka kaun sa group antibiotics ka achha zariya mana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat si antibiotics, maslan tetracycline, chloramphenicol, erythromycin aur neomycin, actinomycetes se hasil hui (2.6).

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the primary function of flagella in bacterial cells?
(Bacteria mein flagella ka bara kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flagella bacteria ko harkat (motility) dete hain; un ka doosra kaam chemical signals ko mehsoos karna hai (2.5).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which type of motility in bacteria is mediated by pili?
(Bacteria mein kaun si harkat pili ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Twitching (rengna) pili se hoti hai: pili sakht satah se chipak kar sukurte (retract) hain aur cell aage khinch jata hai (2.3).

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following bacterial structures is responsible for detecting and responding to chemicals?
(Bacteria ka kaun sa hissa chemicals ko mehsoos karne aur un par radd-e-amal ka zimmedar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flagella ka doosra kaam chemical signals ko mehsoos kar ke un par radd-e-amal dena hai (2.5). Sahi option teesra (c) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein teesra option "(b) Flagella" chhapa hai, yani label (b) do dafa aaya hai. Yeh option (c) hai: (a) Capsule, (b) Pili, (c) Flagella, (d) Ribosomes. Jawab: (c) Flagella.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which one of the following are not Nitrifying bacteria?
(In mein se kaun se nitrifying bacteria nahi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter nitrifying (chemosynthetic) bacteria hain; Pseudomonas denitrifying (nitrate ko nitrogen gas mein badalne wala) bacterium hai (2.7), is liye nitrifying nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq do options sahi bante hain. Azotobacter (c) bhi nitrifying nahi; yeh nitrogen fix karne wala bacterium hai (2.6 mein kitab khud ise nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria mein likhti hai). 2.7 mein Azotobacter ko ghalti se nitrifying likha gaya hai; usi text ke mutabiq kitab ka murad jawab (d) Pseudomonas hai, jo denitrifying hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. The enzyme responsible for converting HIV RNA into DNA is:
(HIV ke RNA ko DNA mein badalne wala enzyme kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: HIV jaise retroviruses mein reverse transcriptase hota hai jo single-stranded RNA se DNA banata hai (reverse transcription) (2.9).

blocks.prompt:
10. The HIV capsid contains:
(HIV ke capsid mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: HIV retrovirus hai: us ke capsid mein single-stranded RNA aur reverse transcriptase enzyme hota hai (2.9).

blocks.prompt:
1. Write about the structural components of a bacterial cell wall and their arrangement.
Bacteria ki cell wall ke hisson aur un ki tarteeb ke bare mein likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Bacteria ki cell wall plasma membrane ke gird ek sakht teh hai, zyada tar peptidoglycan (murein) ki, jis se lipids jure hote hain.
Gram-positive: membrane ke oopar peptidoglycan ki moti teh, lipid kam.
Gram-negative: periplasmic space mein peptidoglycan ki patli teh, us ke oopar lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane jis mein porin proteins hain. Kuch bacteria mein wall ke bahar capsule hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Write the composition of the peptidoglycan layer in bacterial cell walls.
Bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan teh ki banawat likhein.
blocks.explanation: Peptidoglycan (murein) ek khaas bara molecule hai jo lambi glycan (polysaccharide) chains se banta hai; yeh chains chhote peptide tukron se aapas mein juri (cross-linked) hoti hain aur jaal jaisi teh banati hain. Gram-positive mein moti, Gram-negative mein patli.

blocks.prompt:
3. What are mesosomes? What are their functions?
Mesosomes kya hain? Un ke kaam kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Mesosomes bacteria ki cell membrane ke andar ki taraf mude hue hisse (invaginations) hain jo cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae ki shakal mein hote hain.
Kaam: DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa lete hain aur respiration ke markaz hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. How can plasmids be used in genetic engineering?
Genetic engineering mein plasmids kaise istemal hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Plasmids chhote, gol, khud copy hone wale extra-chromosomal DNA molecules hain. Genetic engineering mein yeh vectors (le jane wale) hain: chuna hua gene plasmid mein jora jata hai jo use bacteria tak pohanchata hai; phir bacteria us gene ki copies (cloning) ya khaas protein banate hain, maslan insaani insulin.

blocks.prompt:
5. Define sporulation.
Sporulation ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Sporulation woh amal hai jis mein bacterium na-muwafiq halaat mein endospore banata hai, yani moti deewar wala, so hua (dormant) aaram ka cell. Muwafiq halaat aane par endospore se naya vegetative cell nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is the function of the bacterial capsule?
Bacteria ke capsule ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Capsule kuch bacteria ki cell wall ke bahar ek jelly jaisi teh hai. Yeh bacterial colonies ko chipchipa banata hai jis se woh satah se chipak jati hain; yeh cell ko sookhne aur white blood cells ke nigalne se bhi bachata hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
7. Write the role of pili in bacterial cells. How do they differ from flagella?
Bacteria mein pili ka kirdar likhein. Yeh flagella se kaise mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: Pili bacteria ko satah se chipkate hain, conjugation (milap) mein hissa lete hain aur twitching harkat mein madad dete hain.

rows: Sukur kar sakht satah par twitching
Ghoom kar pani mein cell ko dhakelte hain
Basal body, hook aur flagellin ka filament

blocks.prompt:
8. What are plasmids, and how do they contribute to enabling bacteria to resistance against unfavourable conditions?
Plasmids kya hain, aur yeh bacteria ko na-muwafiq halaat ke khilaf muzahimat (resistance) mein kaise madad dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Plasmids bacterial chromosome ke ilawa chhote, gol, double-stranded, khud copy hone wale DNA molecules hain. In mein izafi genes hote hain, maslan antibiotic resistance ke, jo bacteria ko na-muwafiq halaat mein zinda rakhte hain; plasmids ek bacterium se doosre mein ja kar yeh genes phaila bhi dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "enabling bacteria to resistance" chhapa hai; durust jumla "enable bacteria to resist" (bacteria ko muzahimat ke qabil banana) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Write about the role of endospores in bacterial survival.
Bacteria ke zinda rehne mein endospores ka kirdar likhein.
blocks.explanation: Endospores moti deewar wale, pani se khali, so hue (dormant) cells hain jo na-muwafiq halaat mein bante hain. Spore coat ki wajah se yeh lambe arse tak sakht halaat jhel lete hain; muwafiq halaat aane par phir naya vegetative cell ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
10. What is the significance of lipopolysaccharides and lipoproteins in Gram-negative bacteria?
Gram-negative bacteria mein lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki kya ahmiyat hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Gram-negative cell wall ki outer membrane banate hain jo patli peptidoglycan teh ke oopar hoti hai. Yeh outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko bohat si antibiotics se mehfooz (resistant) banati hai, aur is ke porin proteins khaas molecules ke liye raaste ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
11. How do spirochetes achieve motility?
Spirochetes harkat kaise karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Spirochaetes axial filament se harkat karte hain, yeh ek badla hua flagellum hai jo periplasmic space mein (cell membrane aur outer membrane ke darmiyan) lambai mein hota hai. Is ke do sets dono siron (poles) par jure hote hain; is se mudna, tairna, rengna aur ghoomna hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
12. Differentiate between twitching and gliding movements in bacterial motility.
Bacteria ki twitching aur gliding harkat mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono sakht satah par harkat hain; twitching pili se, gliding chipchipe maadde (slime) se.

rows: Pili satah se chipak kar sukurte hain aur cell khinchta hai

blocks.prompt:
13. How do bacteria without flagella achieve motility?
Baghair flagella wale bacteria harkat kaise karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Twitching (pili chipak kar sukurte hain), gliding (slime nikal kar phisalna), sliding (taqseem hote cells ka dhakka) aur Brownian movement (pani ke zarron ki wajah se be-tarteeb harkat, maslan Streptococcus).

blocks.prompt:
14. What is the difference between swimming motility and swarming motility in bacteria?
Bacteria mein swimming aur swarming harkat mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono flagella se hoti hain; swimming akele cell ki, swarming poori population ki.

rows: Akele cells flagella se chalte hain
Poori bacterial population mil kar flagella se chalti hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Short Q14 kitab mein page 47 ke bilkul neeche (inquisitive sawalon ke baad) chhapa hai, magar yeh short questions ka 14wan sawal hai, is liye yahan short sawalon ke saath rakha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Compare and contrast the cell wall of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono cell walls plasma membrane ke gird sakht teh hain jo zyada tar peptidoglycan ki hain (glycan chains chhote peptides se juri), aur un se lipids jure hote hain. Gram's staining mein Gram-positive violet rang pakar lete hain aur jamni dikhte hain, Gram-negative rang nahi pakarte aur apne asal rang mein dikhte hain. Farq table mein hain.

rows: Lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane
Porin proteins raaste (pores) ka kaam karte hain
Bohat si antibiotics ka asar zyada
Outer membrane ki wajah se bohat si antibiotics se mehfooz
Flagellum ki basal body: rings ka ek joda
Flagellum ki basal body: rings ke do jode

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain different methods of movement in bacteria.
Bacteria mein harkat ke mukhtalif tareeqe bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bacteria apne mahol mein harkat ke liye mukhtalif tareeqe istemal karte hain:
1. Flagellar movement (tairna): zyada tar bacilli aur spirilla pani mein flagella se tairte hain. Flagellum ka ulti ghari (counter-clockwise) ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai, flagellum peeche rehta hai. Jab poori population mil kar flagella se chale to ise swarming kehte hain.
2. Twitching (rengna): sakht satah par pili se harkat; pili satah se chipak kar sukurte hain aur cell aage khinch jata hai.
3. Gliding: twitching jaisi, magar bacteria chipchipa maadda (slime) nikalte hain jis se satah par hamwaar phisalte hain.
4. Sliding: taqseem hote cells ke dhakke se phailao ki wajah se harkat.
5. Brownian movement: baghair flagella ya pili wale bacteria (maslan Streptococcus) pani ke zarron ki harkat se be-tarteeb hilte hain.
6. Axial filament se harkat: spirochaetes mein badla hua flagellum (axial filament) periplasmic space mein lambai mein hota hai, dono siron par jure fibrils ke do sets; is se mudna, tairna, rengna aur ghoomna hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the structure of bacterium flagellum.
Bacterial flagellum ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bacteria ka flagellum eukaryotic flagellum se bilkul mukhtalif hai: yeh microtubules ke 9+2 pattern par nahi bana aur membrane se dhaka nahi; yeh flagellin protein ka bana hai. Is ke teen hisse hain:
1. Basal body: cell membrane ke bilkul neeche; ghoomne wale rings par mushtamil, Gram-positive mein ek joda aur Gram-negative mein do jode. Rings flagellum ko membrane aur cell wall mein jamaye rakhte aur ghumate hain.
2. Hook: mura hua hissa jo basal body ko filament se jorta hai.
3. Filament: cell ke bahar lamba, helical, khokhla, chabuk jaisa hissa, flagellin ka bana; is ka ulti ghari ghoomna cell ko aage dhakelta hai.
Flagella ki tarteeb: atrichous (koi nahi), monotrichous (ek sire par ek), lophotrichous (ek sire par guchha), amphitrichous (dono siron par), peritrichous (chaaron taraf).
Diagram: cell wall aur membrane ka section, un ke aar paar basal body ke rings, bahar mura hua hook aur lamba filament banayein; labels: basal body, rings, hook, filament, cell wall, plasma membrane.

blocks.prompt:
4. State the formation of endospore in bacteria.
Bacteria mein endospore banne ka amal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bohat se bacteria sakht halaat mein endospores bana kar lambe arse zinda rehte hain; endospore moti deewar wala, so hua aaram ka cell hai. Is amal ko sporulation kehte hain:
1. Na-muwafiq halaat mein bacterium apna DNA copy karta hai.
2. Cell membrane ek septum (parda) banati hai jo naye DNA aur thore cytoplasm ko alag karta hai.
3. Cell membrane phir naye DNA, cytoplasm aur septum ke gird barhti hai, yun naya DNA do membranes mein ghir jata hai.
4. Vegetative cell ka DNA toot jata hai aur poora cell pani khone (dehydrate) lagta hai.
5. Do membranes ke darmiyan peptidoglycan ki nayi teh banti hai.
6. Us ke gird spore coat banta hai aur yeh pak kar endospore ban jata hai.
7. Vegetative cell toot jata hai aur endospore azad ho jata hai.
Muwafiq halaat wapas aane tak endospore so raha hota hai; phir germinate ho kar naya vegetative cell banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Briefly describe the ecological and economic importance of bacteria.
Bacteria ki ecological aur economic ahmiyat mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ecological ahmiyat:
1. Qudrat ke recyclers: bacteria taqreeban tamam biogeochemical cycles mein hissa lete hain. Nitrifying (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter) aur denitrifying (Pseudomonas) bacteria nitrogen cycle mukammal karte hain; nitrogen fix karne wale (Azotobacter, cyanobacteria) hawa ki nitrogen ko kaam ka banate hain.
2. Decomposers mare hue organic maadde ko tor kar carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle chalate hain.
3. Photosynthetic cyanobacteria ne hawa mein oxygen barhai aur carbon fix karte hain.
4. Mahol ki safai (bioremediation): sewage ko tor dena, tel ke phailao (oil spill) ke hydrocarbons hazam karna, industrial zehreele fuzlaat khatam karna.
Economic ahmiyat:
1. Khoraak: Lactobacillus (yeast aur molds ke saath) cheese, dahi, achaar, sirka, soy sauce banata hai.
2. Sanat (industry): chemicals, antibiotics (actinomycetes) aur chamra (leather) tayyar karna.
3. Biopesticides: Bacillus thuringiensis keeron ko mehfooz tareeqe se qaboo karta hai.
4. Research aur biotechnology: insaani genes bacteria mein daal kar insulin, growth hormone aur antibodies banana.
(Nuqsaan: kuch bacteria bimariyan dete hain, maslan TB, leprosy, syphilis aur plants ki bimariyan.)

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the use of bacteria in research and technology.
Research aur technology mein bacteria ka istemal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bacteria jaldi barhte hain aur un mein tabdeeli karna aasan hai, is liye molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry mein istemal hote hain:
1. Genes aur enzymes ka mutala: scientists bacterial DNA mein mutation kar ke tabdeel khususiyaat dekhte hain; is se genes aur enzymes ka kaam maloom hota hai jo phir pecheeda jandaron par lagaya jata hai.
2. Dawai wale proteins: insaani genes bacteria mein daale jate hain jo insulin, growth hormone ya antibodies banate hain.
3. Plasmids bataur vectors: chune hue genes plasmids ke zariye bacteria mein bheje jate hain, cloning ya khaas protein ke liye.
4. Bacteriophages bataur carriers: matloob gene phage ke DNA mein jora jata hai jo use bacteria mein le jata hai; transgenic bacteria se gene ki copies aur protein hasil hota hai.
5. Doosri technology: bioremediation (sewage, oil spills, zehreele fuzlaat), biopesticides (Bacillus thuringiensis), antibiotics aur chemicals ki tayyari.

blocks.prompt:
7. Define the term normal flora. State the benefits which we get from normal bacterial flora.
Normal flora ki tareef karein. Normal bacterial flora se hamein kya faide milte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Normal flora: sehatmand jism ke kisi hisse par baqaidgi se paye jane wale microorganisms ka majmooa. Andar ke tissues (khoon, dimagh, muscle) aam tor par jaraseem se paak hote hain, magar bahar ke tissues (jild aur mucous membranes) par jaraseem aabaad hote hain. Insaan mein yeh bacteria (sab se zyada), kuch fungi aur protists aur kuch methanogenic archaea par mushtamil hai. Yeh rishta mutualistic (dono ka faida) hai: flora ko ghiza, mustaqil mahol, ek jaisa darja-e-hararat, hifazat aur transport milti hai.
Hamare faide:
1. Vitamins banana: aanton ke bacteria izafi vitamins dete hain jo jazb hote hain, maslan vitamin K aur vitamin B12; lactic acid bacteria kuch B-vitamins.
2. Bimari wale jaraseem ko jagah na dena: normal flora chipakne ki jagah aur ghiza ke liye pathogens se muqabla karta hai.
3. Pathogens ko rokna ya maarna: aanton ke bacteria aise maadde banate hain jo pathogens ko rokte ya maarte hain.
4. Cross-reactive antibodies: flora antigen ka kaam karta hai; is ke khilaf bani thori antibodies kuch pathogens par bhi asar karti hain aur infection rokti hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain the structure of a model bacteriophage and HIV.
Ek model bacteriophage aur HIV ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bacteriophage (T4 phage), ek pecheeda virus jo Escherichia coli jaise bacteria par hamla karta hai:
1. Sir (head): lamba, pyramid jaisa, chhe pehlu (hexagonal) prism shakal; capsid proteins ka aur core mein lamba double-stranded DNA.
2. Gardan (neck): tail ki sheath ko sir se jorti hai.
3. Dum (tail): seedhi, andar core (nali) aur bahar sukurne wali sheath, dono mukhtalif proteins ki.
4. End plate sheath ke aakhir mein, jis se chhe tail fibres jure hain; tail fibres phage ko bacterial wall se chipakate hain. Yeh sab proteins ke bane hain.
HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus), ek retrovirus:
1. Gol (spherical), taqreeban 100 nm qutr (diameter).
2. Core: single-stranded RNA (genome) aur reverse transcriptase enzyme, protein capsid ke andar.
3. Envelope: capsid ke gird lipid wala envelope jo host cell se banta hai.
4. Envelope mein glycoprotein spikes virus ko apne target cell ko pehchanne aur chipakne mein madad dete hain.
Reverse transcriptase RNA se DNA banata hai (reverse transcription), phir DNA ka double helix mukammal karta hai. HIV se AIDS hoti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Phage ko aise yaad rakhein: sir mein DNA (khazana), dum ek injection jaisi nali, aur neeche taangein (tail fibres) jo bacterium par utar kar chipak jati hain. HIV ek gol gend hai jis ki bahar ki khaal (envelope) par kaante (spikes) hain aur andar RNA aur reverse transcriptase.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why do bacteria have ribosomes even though they do not have membrane-bound organelles?
Bacteria mein membrane-bound organelles nahi hote, phir bhi un mein ribosomes kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Har zinda cell ko proteins (enzymes, banawat aur transport ke proteins) banane parte hain aur ribosomes protein banane ki machine hain. Ribosomes membrane wale organelles nahi; yeh rRNA aur protein ke chhote daane hain, is liye prokaryotes mein bhi hote hain. Bacteria ke ribosomes chhote (70S: 50S aur 30S subunits) hain aur cytoplasm mein azad ya plasma membrane se halke jure hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. If bacteria do not have mitochondria, how do they generate energy for survival?
Agar bacteria mein mitochondria nahi to woh zinda rehne ke liye energy kaise banate hain?
blocks.explanation: Bacteria respiration cell membrane aur us ke mude hisson (mesosomes) par karte hain jo respiration ke markaz hain; respiration ke enzymes membrane aur cytoplasm mein hote hain. Kuch bacteria oxygen ke baghair fermentation se energy lete hain, photosynthetic bacteria (cyanobacteria) roshni se, aur chemosynthetic bacteria (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter) nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke inorganic compounds ko oxidize kar ke energy lete hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why do certain bacteria exhibit twitching motility using pili instead of flagella?
Kuch bacteria flagella ke bajaye pili se twitching harkat kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Flagella tairne se kaam karte hain jis ke liye pani (liquid) chahiye. Jo bacteria sakht ya geeli satah par rehte hain (maslan host ke tissues par) woh wahan tair nahi sakte; pili satah ko pakar kar sukurte hain aur cell ko aage khinchte hain. Pili cell ko mazbooti se chipkaye bhi rakhte hain, is liye bacterium chipka bhi rehta hai aur chal bhi sakta hai, jis se satah par aabaad hona aasan hota hai (kuch hissa chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
4. Give reasons in favour of the statement “Prevention is better than cure” and present your arguments in the class.
"Prevention is better than cure" (bachao ilaaj se behtar hai) ke haq mein dalail dein aur class mein pesh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dalail (chapter se aage, us ki misalon ke saath):
1. Kuch bimariyon ka ilaaj hi nahi: AIDS jaan leva hai kyun ke immune system ke baghair koi zinda nahi rehta, is liye infection se bachna hi mehfooz raasta hai.
2. Ilaaj mehenga aur takleef deh hai; bachao (safai, saaf pani, vaccination) sasta hai aur waqt, paisa aur takleef bachata hai.
3. Antibiotics ka zyada istemal bacteria ko resistant bana deta hai (resistance ke plasmid genes bacteria mein phail jate hain), phir ilaaj nakaam ho sakta hai; bachao antibiotics ka istemal kam karta hai.
4. Ek shakhs ko bachane se bimari doosron tak nahi phailti; ghar aur muashra mehfooz rehte hain.
5. Aasan tadabeer: haath dhona, saaf khana, check kiya hua khoon, jaraseem se paak syringes aur aalaat, vaccines.
Nateeja: bachao sehat ko poori tarah mehfooz rakhta hai, jabke ilaaj nuqsaan hone ke baad hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Correlate the social and cultural values of a country with the prevalence of AIDS.
Kisi mulk ki samaji aur saqafati aqdaar (values) ka AIDS ke phailao se taluq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
HIV zyada tar ghair mehfooz jinsi taluq, mutasira khoon aur khoon ki products, mushtarka sui (syringe) aur mutasira maa se bachche ko phailta hai (chapter se aage; chapter khoon ki products ke zariye phailao ka zikr karta hai).
Aqdaar jo AIDS kam karti hain: shadi ke andar wafadari aur kai saathiyon se parhez; mazboot khandani aur mazhabi aqdaar jo nasha se rokti hain; HIV ke bare mein shaoor aur taleem; zimmedar tibbi tareeqe (check kiya hua khoon, nayi syringes).
Asbaab jo barhate hain: nasha aur sui ka mushtarka istemal, ghair mehfooz rawaiya, kam taleem aur la-ilmi, ghair mehfooz tibbi tareeqe (syringe dobara istemal, be-check khoon), aur bimari ko sharm samajhna (stigma) jis se log test aur ilaaj se katrate hain.
Yani jis mulk ki aqdaar akhlaqi rawaiye, sehat ki khuli taleem aur mareezon se hamdardi ko farogh dein wahan AIDS kam hoti hai; la-ilmi, stigma aur khatarnaak tareeqe ise barhate hain.

items: MCQs ke jawab chapter ke text se: 1d 2c 3b 4d 5c 6c 7c 8d 9b 10b.

MCQ 7 mein option label (b) do dafa chhapa hai (Flagella asal mein (c) hai); MCQ 8 mein Azotobacter bhi nitrifying nahi, is liye do options sahi bante hain; kitab ka murad jawab (d) Pseudomonas hai ("Kitab ki ghalti" boxes).
Short (14), long (8) aur inquisitive (5) sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain.
